source: QED 3-loop electron self-energy — Transverse-Cross (TX) — pairing (1,6)(2,4)(3,5). Outer envelope photon gamma_16 + 2 inner crossed photons gamma_24, gamma_35. 2-particle reducible (cut e2+e6). e2 and e6 carry the same momentum p-l1 by topology (not routing artifact), so the IBP family has 7 distinct main propagators + 2 ISPs; the target integral is [2,1,1,1,1,1,1,0,0] — index 2 on the shared electron propagator. Validates AMFlow on doubled-propagator family.
